Objections pre-answered

The pitch's credibility lives here: name the objections a skeptical maintainer actually raises, then answer them before they ask.

“…scope/effort — this is bigger than it looks.”

[What is actually small/shared/already-built; where the real boundary is.]

“…maintenance — who owns this after the slice closes?”

[Owner, regeneration path, and what health checks exist.]

“…this duplicates [existing thing].”

[One-line diff vs the existing thing; why the existing thing is not the right layer.]
